historical_record.description: The City Planning Commission approved the certificate of appropriateness to allow new construction on a vacant lot within a historic district.
The City Planning Commission approved the conditional use to develop six market-rate residential units.
The City Planning Commission did not take discretionary review and approved the project to change the use from a vacant lot to a new building with six residential units and one commercial unit.
The property was a vacant lot.
